Back: kill the sleeve (tori grabs uke sleeve but uke pulls it back); post to lapel (tori grabs collar instead); around the back (uke reaches for tori collar same side); the catch (tori stops with opposite hand and hands the sleeve to their other hand)

kenka stance; stiff arm them to shift their balance off closer foot; step in to hook their foot from behind it; bring arm close so youre touching; pull them down to fall. Variation: similar to hiza guruma — place back foot behind front foot; hook uke's inner foot and pull down.
similar to o uchi gari; dominant foot sweeps uke's opposite foot toward you with a half step de ashi rhythm; point other foot in direction of throw; blanket shake arms to bring uke up then down
use arm to lift uke; sweep their feet into each other.
kenka yotsu stance; step betwen uke's legs; turn and pull uke forward onto hip; turn uke while sweeping inner leg from the inside; flip and roll over.
tori rotates back to uke offset at the hip 70/30; far ankle blocks uke's far ankle; tori lowers as pulling uke over leg; tori raises to pop uke over leg.
ai yotsu stance gripping upper lapel; step in front of uke's outer foot; turn while pulling uke forward onto hip; turn uke while sweeping outer leg from the outside; flip and roll over.

Like o goshi but wrap deep around uke's neck and drive toward the mat; variation: stick out hip/leg and fall toward uke's foot ("ass koshi guruma"); defense: block with arm or pick tori up; counter: transition into seoi nage.
ai yotsu stance; tori turns 180 pulling uke's sleeve over like a seatbelt; lapel elbow bends into their armpit; tori squats and pulls uke over lower back like uki goshi.

Front: Counter Osoto Gari with Osoto Gaeshi
Back: when tori tries to reap; uke holds their elbow tight and backfoot steps forward to shift their weight; then does osoto on them

Front: Counter O Goshi with outside leg jump around to De Ashi Barai
Back: when tori turns around; uke steps outside to their front while grabbing their lapel and extending leg to do de ashi

uke posts upward to block 3/4 nelson hold; tori grabs inside of neck lapel with thumb out; grab other side with other hand; pull uke up facing opposite direction; tori moves inner leg forward and pulls uke back down; choke hold created between both hands.
clock choke; uke face down; feed one hand lapel across under neck; other hand grabs wrist through under arm; legs walk around uke head.
Tori on top flat uke; hands flat on chest; bring feet up into s shape cradling head; grab tricep; lean toward uke hips; move leg around while falling back and pull outer arm into armbar.
like drill A but go from top mount to s mount in one movement; uke folds arms to block; tori can swap sides if uke's top arm is locked by pulling legs and getting back into s mount.
tori from full guard; when uke places arm on ground; tori uses their own neck as fulcrum to bar ukes arm.

tori grabs uke's collar; steps over uke; pulls back collar so knee goes under uke's elbow and foot goes around neck; tucks other elbow and grabs other arm; rolls toward tucked elbow; uke lands on back in triangle hold with armbar.
from uki gatame armbar; uke grabs own lapel and pulls tori's leg over head and behind; uke sits up toward tori stacking them backward; uke steps over tori's leg; transition to any pin.
tori pulls lapel out and feeds it across uke belly to other arm. a. lapel pulled on far side; uke rolls over tori. b. lapel pulled on tori side; tori flips over uke.
from side; pull uke out to make space; step over and around neck; knee and foot touch; whale forward; triangle lock; hook leg with arm.

from top; pull uke out to make space; knee against neck; other foot around waste; knee and foot touch; grab belt and knee side elbow; pull uke back over head and onto back; pull arm under face; triangle neck and pinch thighs to choke. Key lock: if choke fails; tori wraps lapel around uke's arm and pulls palm down; tori can then transition to kami shiho gatame etc.

Front: Turtle - Double hand belt pull drill
Back: v1: crab ride from white belt test; v2: uke goes facedown after crab ride and tori does okuri eri jime (aka clock choke) with left arm above uke's left arm and hip on ukes right shoulder; v3: uke lands on back but frees leg so tori moves left arm under ukes head to grab hands and windshield wipers onto mount to get tate shiho gatame.

v1: shoulder roll into kami from white belt; v2: uke posts out so tori slides palm up across neck instead and grabs hands to roll uke by the neck into kazuri kami; v3: uke posts up so tori feeds lapel to palm then uses top arm to grab collar by 11 oclock then pulls up uke swings leg 180 and pulls down uke into gyaku juji jime.

a. pull uke left arm to the right; grab belt; shrimp to 90; hook leg and call the phone; flip. b. Make slack on uke left collar and then grab with left; pull forward; right leg onto sternum; pull uke overhead left and scissor legs to flip.

Front: Half guard - Uke grabs tori over shoulder
Back: from top half guard; tori leans diagonally over uke and slides the outer arm between uke's neck and arm; other hand pulls uke's arm down and monkey-paws the wrist; outer hand monkey-paws the first hand; drive knee into uke's armpit and lean back for ude garami; rotate slowly toward uke's head for the tap.

Front: Half guard - Uke grabs tori around torso
Back: from top half guard; tori lays across uke sideways; both hands go under uke's trapped leg below the knee and pull to free the leg; slide the arm around uke's neck and settle into yoko shiho gatame.

from top half guard; tori threads arms into kesa or kata gatame and walks up to build an A frame; use the free foot's sole to push uke's top leg down and free the trapped leg; drop into gatame to finish the pass.

from top half guard with uke arms locked around tori; tori uses arm to choke uke to release arm; tori then flattens out ukes arm with toris arm under armbit as fulcrum; tori uses wrist pressure to armbar.
kuzuri kesa; into mune gatame; into ushiro kesa gatame; into tate shiho gatame; into uki gatame; into juji gatame.

uke in turtle; tori steps one leg over uke's waist and the other behind their neck; tori posts then leans forward onto uke's head; hooks uke's near arm with own arm and grabs back of uke's thigh; pulls uke's leg over their neck; rolls uke over tori's leg and over their own head; lands into juji gatame.
